run_tsne_visualization: run t-SNE visualization on model features from a config file and checkpoint
run_tsne_with_custom_classes: run t-SNE visualization for specific class indices with custom perplexity and learning rate
run_tsne_backbone_features: run t-SNE visualization on backbone features extracted from a pretrained model
run_tsne_with_legend: run t-SNE visualization and display a legend of all categories in the plot
run_tsne_neck_features: run t-SNE visualization on neck stage features with custom max samples per class
